members.name: routing_v5
members.instructions: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to the support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about? Pick the option that best matches the customer's main request.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card purchase or payment on the statement that the customer did not make or does not recognise (unknown merchant).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal (or withdrawn amount) appears in the app that the customer says they did not make; they disown it rather than saying the ATM handed over too little.
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit taken from the account that the customer does not recognise or did not authorise.
criteria.compromised_card: Customer explicitly believes someone else has used, hacked or compromised their card details or account, and wants to freeze or secure it.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Customer's card is lost, missing or stolen and they want to report it, block it or know what to do; including objections to fees or charges that arose because the card was stolen; not a request to order a replacement card and learn its price.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Customer's phone is lost, stolen or left somewhere and they worry about access to the app.
criteria.unknown_money_received: The customer reports that money they did not add has appeared in their account, treating it as unexplained or suspicious activity.
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund from a merchant or to return an item / cancel a purchase and get money back.
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund the customer was promised or expects has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.charged_twice: The same purchase or transaction appears two or more times; customer was charged in duplicate.
criteria.wrong_cash_amount: The customer did not receive the cash amount they asked for at the ATM: it dispensed less cash than requested, while the account was debited for the requested amount.
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was reverted, cancelled or returned and the customer asks why or what it means.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Customer wants to cancel, stop or reverse a transfer or transaction they made, e.g. sent to the wrong account by mistake.
criteria.activate_card: How to activate a new card or whether it needs activation.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived yet; tracking the card delivery.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, or whether it can be delivered at a chosen time or place.
criteria.card_linking: Adding, linking or showing a card in the app, including re-adding a card that was found again.
criteria.card_not_working: Card has stopped working in general, without a specific declined purchase or ATM.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card purchase or payment (in a shop or online) was declined or rejected.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is about to expire or has expired; getting a replacement.
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted: which shops, ATMs or places take it.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, retained or swallowed the customer's card.
criteria.order_physical_card: How to order or get a physical (plastic) card, including from abroad.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional or second card, e.g. for a family member, and how many cards one can have.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get or access a virtual card, or why it has not been issued.
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: What disposable (single-use) virtual cards are and how to get one.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits on disposable virtual cards: how many can be created, how many uses.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual or disposable card is not working or is being rejected.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Any question framed around the Visa and Mastercard networks: which of them the bank issues or accepts, or choosing between them; also which kinds of card (credit, debit) the bank itself issues to its customers. Not whether the bank accepts the customer's own card from elsewhere.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which types of the customer's own cards from elsewhere, or which currencies, can be used to add money to the account, or whether a particular such card or currency is supported; not a question about Visa versus Mastercard.
criteria.change_pin: How or where to change, reset or replace an existing card PIN with a different one.
criteria.pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked or rejected, or the customer has forgotten a PIN they had.
criteria.get_pin_new_card: Getting or setting the first PIN for a new or physical card: where to find it, how to set it up initially, how it will be received, or not having been given one yet.
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, or general help using the card at ATMs.
criteria.card_spending_limit: Daily or spending limits on the card.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment is still pending and has not completed.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal the customer made still shows as pending, or has not yet been deducted from or shown in the balance.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM or bank refused or declined the customer's card or withdrawal attempt, so no withdrawal went through.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is still pending; why it is pending or when it will clear.
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive, incl. international or from Europe.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Customer sent money but the recipient has not received it.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through, and the customer asks why.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Customer cannot add or send money to a particular payee or beneficiary.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to move money into the account from another bank account; receiving a transfer into the account.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money or a salary into the account, possibly in another currency.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_transfer: Money sent into the account by bank transfer is not yet reflected in the balance.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit was made but the balance has not updated.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: How or where to top up / deposit money with cash or a cheque.
criteria.top_up_by_card: The steps for topping up the account with a card the customer already knows is supported.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer: How to top up the account using a bank transfer.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Topping up or paying with Apple Pay, Google Pay or similar wallets.
criteria.automatic_top_up: Setting up automatic top-ups when the balance is low.
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending or the customer asks its status.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up failed or was declined, or money the customer added or moved has vanished from the balance without them blaming anyone else.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reverted, returned or cancelled after it seemed to work.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on how much or how often the account can be topped up.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verification codes or checks required for a top-up.
criteria.pending_payment_general: A payment or transaction has not completed yet, general status question.
criteria.payment_cancelled: A payment was cancelled without the customer knowing why.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment or transaction the customer made, and they attribute the fee to their payments (asking why their payments carry fees).
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee was charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM, or what ATM fees are.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer, or what transfer fees are, including when the recipient got less than the amount sent because something was deducted.
criteria.top_up_charge: Fees for topping up the account (by card, bank transfer, international card).
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small extra fee or charge on the statement that the customer does not link to a specific card payment, ATM withdrawal, transfer or top-up.
criteria.exchange_rate: How exchange rates are set or what rate the customer will get.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange currencies in the app.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the account can hold or exchange.
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card purchase abroad was converted at a wrong or worse exchange rate.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_wrong_exchange_rate: An ATM withdrawal abroad used a wrong exchange rate.
criteria.card_fees: The customer wants to obtain a card and asks its price: fees for ordering, delivering or replacing a physical card (including ordering a replacement after a loss), or for an additional card. Not fees for exchanging money or using the card, and not complaints about charges.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity or which documents are needed.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification is failing or the customer lacks ID.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Proving the source of funds, or the customer asking where the funds in their account came from.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing personal details such as name, address or phone number.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten or reset the app passcode; cannot log in to the app.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open an account.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank serves, whether people living outside the bank's home country can become customers or get its cards, or where the account can be used.
